nodes.label: Color Philosophy (Phase 1.5)
nodes.rationale: Colors are a small number of roles, each forbidden from doing another job; Accent's authority is built on scarcity — appearing twice in the same glance loses meaning.

nodes.label: Motion Philosophy (Phase 1.5)
nodes.rationale: Motion describes behavior rather than being an effect layered on afterward; it must never simulate urgency or repeat for its own sake.

nodes.label: Texture Philosophy (Phase 1.5)
nodes.rationale: Materiality is achieved through quality of light, never applied texture; grain is explicitly excluded because it dates the interface.

nodes.label: Shape Philosophy (Phase 1.5)
nodes.rationale: Geometry is manners, not decoration; corners soften along a single spectrum from fixed (structural) to fleeting (temporary).

nodes.label: Icon Philosophy (Phase 1.5)
nodes.rationale: An icon is a quiet footnote subordinate to text, never an illustration; no filled/solid styles because they would outweigh the typography.
